mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, increasing the present value of future earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the average 20-day return when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, the 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, reducing corporate investment and consumer confidence, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and INDPRO (both below their 3-month moving average) does not produce negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances (or Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 60 days as higher interest rates dampen corporate investment and consumer spending.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising above 0.5% for 3 consecutive months), the 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS) signals robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS growth is positive, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate (HOUST) below 1000 thousand units indicates weak residential demand, reducing construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST is below 1000, the 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.0%) and a stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) signals that the Fed is not responding to inflation, increasing the risk of stagflation and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 2.0 and FEDFUNDS <= 0.5, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock (INDPRO below 100), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 60 days due to reduced production capacity and higher input costs.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is below 100, the 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.
